$comment: Golden target versions for the VMOS Edge fleet. This is the REFERENCE every box must converge to. The vendor layer (cbs_go, kernel, android image) is not shippable from this repo (proprietary binaries) — it is propagated box-to-box from the reference box via scripts/deploy-vendor.sh. The proxy version is NOT recorded here: it is read from infra/magicbox-proxy/package.json (the code IS the source of truth). check-drift.mjs compares every live box against these values.
captured_from: box-5.attila.army /v1/systeminfo + list_names image + cloudflared tunnel connection

minimums.$comment: Floor required for the Android Control API v2 (input/click, accessibility/dump, node find-and-act). New devices/boxes must meet these. Source: help.vmosedge.com/en/sdk/agent-api.

provisioning.$comment: New devices MUST be created on this image so they are born fleet-aligned. Pass it to MagicBox-Industrial provisioning as --image-repository <golden_image> (it defaults to VMOS's ancient built-in image otherwise). This file is the single source of truth for the value.

reference_capacity.$comment: Fleet policy (2026-07-07): max_concurrent_containers = 10 on every box — the VMOS host ceiling (AGENTS.md) proven on box-5 at 16GB RAM. box-1 has 32GB, box-2/4 have 16GB like box-5, so 10 is safe fleet-wide. operator_reserve stays 1 (automator uses max-1). check-drift flags divergence from this value.
